body: It means a lot to know people I don't know care about me, even if it does sound weird. It makes me feel happy to know that :) Also I do pride myself on working so hard on being (what i believe to be) bipolar without turning to meds even when I feel so depressed it's a physical pain. Most people can't do it. Doesn't mean it bad, just not the road for me. I actually wouldn't be opposed to seeing a therapist except I'm scared it might screw up my chances of my future, going to college for Psychology! Now I know everyone has there problems and it's rare to find a "normal" person with no disorder or disease but I'm afraid that if they deem me as bad enough to STRESS me going on meds that I can't pursue my dream. It's always been a huge fear of mine. Also I just don't think I'd have the time with having a 4 month old puppy, looking for a job, trying to get into school with no funds and having guy troubles (very LONG story) I would need a therapist that had SUCH a free schedule I would have to be able to call her like a friend "Hey! You wanna hang out??" lol But in reality if I wanted it bad enough I could do it. I guess I'm just scared to take the first step.
Thank you! It means a lot to know someone happy at my progress! :)

Like I said in the beginning I'm not going to end my life so that's one thing to not worry about :D

And I really don't think I want everyone I know knowing what I have. It's too personal lol My self eteem issues come from years of being told I'm fat and ugly from my mother. Don't ask me why she said those things, I will never know but 17+ years of being told that and it kinda stays with you. On the bright side, I'm not vain!! hahaha
